experiment_metadata.purpose: Measure performance and training-time scaling for the best 500k finite-composition configuration per tabular algorithm.

baseline.name: stick_on_17
baseline.description: Hit when the player sum is below 17; stick on 17 or above.

reference.title: Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction
reference.authors: Richard S. Sutton and Andrew G. Barto
